summary: Implemented the JSON pretty-printing feature per the spec: JSONHighlighter in rich/highlighter.py; six json.* theme entries in rich/default_styles.py; new rich/json.py with the JSON renderable and a main-guarded CLI; Console.print_json in rich/console.py; package-level print_json in rich/__init__.py; new tests/test_json.py; docs (console.rst "Printing JSON" section, new reference/json.rst, reference.rst toctree entry); and a CHANGELOG Unreleased/Added entry. Nothing was run or committed, so the tests are unverified. Two choices to check: Console is imported only inside the __main__ block of rich/json.py (the CLI needs a stderr console), and overflow "none" is set as Python None.
